newsitem.title: FRANCE: Exporters bid aggressively in Tunisia wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: Exporters bid aggressively in Tunisia wheat tender.

text.p: Exporters taking part in Tunisia's tender to buy 100,000 tonnes of soft wheat have placed very aggressive bids, European traders said on Thursday.
"The offers were very aggressive (price-wise)," one trader said.
Tunisia is seeking to import 100,000 tonnes of optional wheat for shipment in January and February.
Traders said cheaper supplies from Argentina and Australia had a competitive edge over European wheat.
One exporter put the lowest-priced offer to supply wheat for January shipment at $152-$154 per tonne, including insurance and freight.
The lowest offer for February shipment was put at around $149 per tonne, including insurance and freight.
One exporter said there was a gap of seven to eight dollars between the lowest and the highest offer placed at the tender. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
